taxonomy.A: genuine behavioral verification gap; potentially eligible for test generation
taxonomy.B: equivalent/non-distinguishable mutation; do not generate a test
taxonomy.C: defensive/intentional behavior; do not manufacture a test for score
taxonomy.D: discovery/test-selection gap; fix at discovery/planning level
taxonomy.E: historical/repeated survivor; generation depends on accumulated evidence
taxonomy.F: measurement/infrastructure failure; repair measurement, do not generate
taxonomy.G: legitimate missing regression; potentially eligible, subject to authorization
